title: Rule-Driven Reservation Safety & Deduplication Engine Contract

verticalIsolationRules.UR: Open merit pool; open to all candidates unless state/recruitment open-merit rule specifies restrictions.
verticalIsolationRules.SC: Eligible for UR and SC vacancies only. Isolated from ST, OBC_NCL, EWS.
verticalIsolationRules.ST: Eligible for UR and ST vacancies only. Isolated from SC, OBC_NCL, EWS.
verticalIsolationRules.OBC_NCL: Eligible for UR and OBC_NCL vacancies only. Isolated from SC, ST, EWS.
verticalIsolationRules.OBC_CL: Creamy layer candidate; by law, ineligible for OBC_NCL reserved quota. Matches UR only.
verticalIsolationRules.EWS: Eligible for UR and EWS vacancies only. Isolated from SC, ST, OBC_NCL.

horizontalQuotaRules.WOMEN: Applicable only to FEMALE candidates. Male candidates strictly rejected.
horizontalQuotaRules.PWBD: Applicable only to candidates with explicit isPwBD === true. Null or false candidates rejected.
horizontalQuotaRules.EX_SERVICEMAN: Applicable only to candidates with explicit isExServiceman === true. Null or false candidates rejected.

vacancyDeduplication.mechanism: Tracks seenRowKeys (rowId or composite of vertical + horizontal + post). Deduplicates identical rows before summing.
vacancyDeduplication.countReconciliation: totalApplicableVacancies computed strictly from deduplicated unique applicable rows.
